verdict.rationale: Khoj ships a self-hostable server, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask for. Nothing in the evidence documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The Ollama and LiteLLM pages describe other servers' OpenAI-compatible APIs that Khoj consumes, not a spec Khoj publishes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
